description: Get a single client group by ClientGroupKey — or by your own UserDefinedIdentifier — optionally expanding related data (BusinessCard, ClientTeam). Includes the group's members (contacts and organizations). Provide exactly one of clientGroupKey or userDefinedIdentifier.

expand.description: Comma-separated related data to include: BusinessCard, ClientTeam

userDefinedIdentifier.description: Look up by your own external ID instead of the ClientGroupKey

name: get_client_group
title: Get client group
